audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text was generic assassin prose and misgendered Katarina throughout ('his engage range', 'tax his approach').
audit.why: Katarina is female per champ-gender.js, and the actual difficulty is specific: Shunpo is a 725-range blink with no travel time to dodge, so Hwei's cast animations are the whole problem.
audit.corrected: Hard at 8/10, 48.37% over 3,430 games. The lane is winnable to level 5 and gets worse every time Voracity refunds her cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[N].side read 'Katarina' at a flat 7/10 while content win[] read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei — seven rows disagreeing across layers.
audit.why: Levels 1-3 Katarina has Bouncing Blade at 625 and no reset, so Hwei is favoured. Levels 4-6 are the coin flip. At first item and beyond, Voracity plus a 45-second Death Lotus favours Katarina, and the sub-50% win rate agrees — the content layer's 'Hwei' on rows 5-6 was the stale half.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side to Hwei, phases[3..4].side to Skill (matching win[]); win[5] and win[6] to Katarina (matching phases[5..6].side). Every why rewritten to the row's verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was absent: Death Lotus is a channel and Hwei's E paints cancel it. Content also used a fabricated Hwei name ('Devastating Fire Painting stun', 'Severalty (Q) wall') and credited Hwei with a stun.
audit.why: Riot's data flags Death Lotus as channel/interruptible; Hwei's E line is Grim Visage (fear), Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw — CC, but no stun. Shunpo is a 725-range blink to a target or her own dagger.
audit.corrected: Hold one E paint for the Death Lotus channel; it cancels a 45-second ultimate outright. Grim Visage on her Shunpo landing is the other use — you only get one.

audit.why: Shunpo 12/11/10/9/8 at 725, Bouncing Blade 11/10/9/8/7 at 625, Death Lotus 75/60/45.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, with the channel-cancel line attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Both replaced with bodies that match their titles.

edits.before: Fear the dive, shield the burst, and tax his approach until your paint out-scales his patience. Every commit starts with one question: is Shunpo down?
edits.after: Fear the dive, cancel the channel, and tax her approach until your paint out-scales her patience. Every commit starts with one question: is Shunpo down?

edits.before: Katarina wins by landing Shunpo, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.

edits.before: QQ his last-hit, weave any second spell for the mark, detonate, and reset to max range — two-spell trades he answers only by overextending.

edits.before: Standing mid-cast-animation inside his engage range with the fear already spent — every assassin and fighter in the pool is waiting for exactly that frame.
